svg.title: Hylo architecture at a glance
svg.desc: Improvement: proposers make candidates, the gate decides, and a version is promoted. The store keeps runs, traces, artifacts, versions and skills. Every episode runs on one loop: the agent proposes an action, the safety shield reviews it and the environment executes it. Serve provides model serving. Five properties hold throughout: one episode loop, one safety shield, sealed traces, a protected scope and pinned robot packs.
